description: Pins the shared linode_id and disk_id rejections, the disk-clone POST, and the preview that reads the disk the copy is made from.

cases.name: rejects missing linode_id
cases.expect_error: linode_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects missing disk_id
cases.expect_error: disk_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects a linode_id below one
cases.expect_error: linode_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects a disk_id below one
cases.expect_error: disk_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This clones a disk, consuming additional storage on the instance. Set confirm=true to proceed.

side_effects: Disk "boot-disk" (25600 MB) is cloned to a new disk on the same instance, consuming 25600 MB of additional storage.
